docs.summary: A tile's layer widened by #SeamBorder cells of its neighbours' layers, heights rebased into this tile's units. -1 marks no surface — rebased neighbour heights can take any value, so the layer's own 0xFF sentinel is not safe here.

docs.summary: Over caller-owned buffers, each at least (width + 2*border) * (height + 2*border) long. Only that prefix is touched — and it is reset here, since a border cell no neighbour covers is left as it was found — so a buffer grown for a bigger tile can be handed back for a smaller one.
